  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  January 09, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on January 09, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Christine Rivera , Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service & Public Safety

  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on December 12, 2024.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Terilyn Ferguson - Profitt on behalf of Girl Scouts of Greater Los Angeles to host a Annual
  Cookie Program Event in various locations; Private Property, from Tuesday, January
  14,2025, Wednesday, April 30, 2025, from 8:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m; Approval for a one day
  event; Applicant shall have children under age 18 years old accompanied by parent must
  have IPD direct number on hand at all times (310) 412-8771; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00395617)

Item #2:  Doris Obih on behalf of 40 Love Foundation to host a Don Bly’s 92 Birthday & Legend
  Celebration Event at 700 Warren Ln Donald BlybTennis Complex; Edward Vincent Jr.
  Park, Public Property on Saturday, February 15, 2025, from 11:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m.
  Approval for one day event aat Edward Vincent Jr. Park; Applicant to hire four (4) Licensed
